newsitem.title: THAILAND: General Finance up in active trading.
newsitem.headline: General Finance up in active trading.

text.p: Shares of General Finance and Securities Plc jumped in early active trade on Tuesday on bargain hunting by investors, brokers said.

At 0455 GMT, General Finance rose 4.50 baht or 8.50 percent to 57.50 after briefly reaching its 10 percent daily limit. Trading was active with 2.85 million shares worth 161 million baht changing hands.

"General Finance's rise today was in line with the rebound in overall market," said one dealer at a local brokerage. "The news of its chairman possibly being included in the group of new economic ministers also contributed to some buying interest."

General Finance's chairman and chief executive officer, Narongchai Akrasanee, has been tipped by local media to be included in the economic team of the new coalition government led by the New Aspiration Party.
